name: zakotu MD10 Mini Body Camera
caption:
A camera smaller than your thumb. 🎥

The zakotu MD10 clips on with a magnet and records in 1080P for about two hours, so walking the dog after dark or dropping off a delivery is on video without holding anything.

Tip: charge it while it records, and it keeps going.
